tagline: Lakebase updated its supported Postgres versions to 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16, less than 30 minutes after the PostgreSQL community released them.
what_it_does: Lakebase updated its supported Postgres versions to 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16, less than 30 minutes after the PostgreSQL community released them. These minor releases include the latest upstream Postgres bug fixes and security patches. Lakebase applies a new minor version the next time your compute restarts.
why_it_matters: These minor releases include the latest upstream Postgres bug fixes and security patches.
